title: Uzungumzaji wa Kushawishi (Theme 8: Misukosuko ya kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans what to say, listens to the end, and replies on the topic in standard Kiswahili with the features of a kushawishi.
steps: Reply on the topic with a reason.
Keep the language and the turn-taking right.

board.do: kujiunga na klabu ya amani shuleni
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child takes part in a short kushawishi on the topic while a partner ticks the checklist.

misconceptions.repair: Kushawishi kunahitaji sababu na faida kwa msikilizaji.
Shawishi kwa hoja na heshima, si vitisho.

misconceptions.ask: Ni maneno yapi si ya Kiswahili sanifu?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.

checks.question: Unawashawishi wenzako wajiunge na klabu ya mazingira. Ni lipi bora?
checks.answer: Jiungeni kwa sababu tutapanda miti, tutajifunza na tutashinda tuzo.
